# OpenDDIL Logistics Fusion Service — LLM Context

This repository (`openddil-logistics-fusion-service`) houses the per-asset
logistics fusion Restate Virtual Object for OpenDDIL Phase 3.5.

## Purpose

One durable `AssetLogistics` Virtual Object instance per `asset_id`.
Consumes:
- `asset-telemetry-windows` (windowed slopes from Faust edge agent)
- `asset-cm-state` (CM state from cm-service)
- `raw-sensor-stream` (Silver telemetry, filtered to sustainment-carrying feeds)

Emits `AssetLogisticsStatusUpdate` to compacted `asset-logistics-status`.

## Key Files

- `src/workflows/asset_logistics.py` — Restate Virtual Object.
  4 handlers: `on_telemetry_window`, `on_cm_state_change`,
  `on_proprietary_update`, `on_timer`.
- `src/fusion/rules.py` — pure-Python `compute_logistics_status`.
  7 evaluators: fuel, ammo, wear, mtbf, subsystems, cm_state, staleness.
  No Faust/Restate/Kafka imports.
- `src/fusion/thresholds.py` — env-driven `Thresholds` dataclass.
- `src/fusion/ontology_check.py` — startup WARN for ontology drift
  between alias files and `platform_reference.yaml`.
- `src/main.py` — hypercorn ASGI server.
- `bootstrap/register_subscriptions.py` — thin wrapper around shared
  `openddil_bootstrap.restate_subscriptions` library.

## Rules

- Persistence/Computation separation (ADR-0006): rules.py is pure
  Python; Faust/Restate/Kafka stay outside.
- Internal severity vocabulary (`LogisticsSeverity_*`) is STABLE.
  Customer-facing labels (FMC/PMC/NMC, green/amber/red) live in the
  egress Bloblang only.
- Fuel% requires platform capacity from `platform_reference.yaml`.
  Unknown variant → return None, don't fabricate.
- Restate state survives Kafka topic purges. Test fixtures use
  `restate state clear "AssetLogistics/<asset_id>"` for fresh state.

## Docker Compose

When consumed by openddil-demo:
- Base `docker-compose.yml` references
  `image: ghcr.io/edgy-solutions/openddil/logistics-fusion-service:latest` for both
  the service and its bootstrap container.
- `docker-compose.override.yml` has the `build:` block + source mounts
  for development.
- NEVER add a `build:` to the base compose. Publish a new image first.
